changelog:
- New streamlined skill for generating two-speaker conversation audio in a single request using inline speaker tags.
- Switch to a concise usage-focused guide; removed long script-writing and usage tips.
- Now relies on Fish Audio S2.1 Pro, detailing schema: `speech.text` (with `<|speaker:N|>` tags) and `speech.voices` (array).
- Clarified that emotion tags are per-speaker and that only two speakers are supported per call.
- Removed the old skill card file and extensive example tables for brevity.
- Emphasizes model/schema validation via `runware-run` and cautions against hardcoding.
summary: Generate a two-speaker conversation as a single audio file. Use when the user says "make a podcast snippet", "two people talking", "a back-and-forth dialogue...
